repo.name: NotificationLog ntfy fork
repo.description:
Self-hosted F-Droid repo for the NotificationLog HTTP webhook fork
(https://github.com/d33mobile/notification-http). Single app:
pl.d33.notificationlog.ntfy. Each push to the webhook-http branch
ships a new versionCode here.

apps.description:
Unofficial fork of jonas-l/notificationlog-android (GPL-3.0-or-later) that
adds optional ntfy.sh-compatible HTTP webhook delivery on top of upstream's
local notification logger.

All upstream functionality is intact:

  * captures every notification via NotificationListenerService
  * stores them locally in a Room database (no network access required)
  * per-app whitelist / blacklist
  * export and clear

Fork additions (all opt-in under Settings):

  * forward each logged notification to a configurable HTTP endpoint
    (Title / Tags / optional Bearer auth headers, body = notification text)
  * offline-resilient: pending deliveries persisted in the same Room
    transaction as the log row, drained by WorkManager with NetworkType.CONNECTED
    and exponential backoff. Survives airplane mode, process kill, reboot.
  * "Skip ongoing notifications" toggle (default ON) suppresses
    foreground-service heartbeats from torrent clients, music players,
    step counters, etc.
  * UTF-8 in title via RFC 2047 encoded-word so Polish/German chars survive.
  * App label prepended to the Title header so subscribers know which
    app the notification came from.

Requires the user to grant Notification Listener access on first run.
apps.summary: Log notifications locally and forward to ntfy.sh
